headline: Obama order sets rules for how the outgoing administration helps prepare the next president to take office.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with the handoff of power from one president to the next. Based on its title, it lays out steps for the outgoing administration and federal agencies to help a new president's team get ready to govern. No official summary was provided, so the specific details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and senior White House staff
who_it_affects.how: They are likely given duties to plan for and support the change to a new administration.
They are likely the ones who receive help and information from the outgoing administration.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 6, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
